    vector<vector<int>> binom(N, vector<int>(N, 0));
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(N, vector<long long>(N, 0));
    vector<vector<long long>> ways(N, vector<long long>(N, 0));

    auto add_mod = [&](int &a, int b) {
        a += b;
        if (a >= mod) a -= mod;
    };

    auto mul_mod = [&](int a, int b) {
        return (long long)a * b % mod;
    };

    auto c2 = [&](int x) {
        return (long long)x * (x + 1) / 2 % mod;
    };

    // Precompute binomial coefficients
    binom[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < N; ++i) {
        binom[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            binom[i][j] = (binom[i - 1][j] + binom[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
        }
    }

    // Calculate blok and sum arrays
    for (int x = 1; x <= m; ++x) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= x; ++i) {
            int temp1 = mul_mod(blok[i - 1], mul_mod(blok[x - i], binom[x - 1][i - 1]));
            add_mod(blok[x], temp1);
            int temp2 = mul_mod(add_mod(c2(i - 1), c2(x - i)), temp1);
            add_mod(sum[x], temp2);
            int temp3 = mul_mod(sum[i - 1], mul_mod(blok[x - i], binom[x - 1][i - 1]));
            add_mod(sum[x], mul_mod(temp3, x + 1));
            int temp4 = mul_mod(sum[x - i], mul_mod(blok[i - 1], binom[x - 1][i - 1]));
            add_mod(sum[x], mul_mod(temp4, x + 1));
        }
        mul_mod(blok[x], x + 1);
    }

    ways[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            for (int sz = 1; sz <= i; ++sz) {
                int temp1 = mul_mod(ways[i - sz][j - 1], mul_mod(blok[sz], binom[m - i + sz][sz]));
                add_mod(ways[i][j], temp1);

                add_mod(dp[i][j], temp2);

                add_mod(dp[i][j], temp3);
            }
        }
    }

    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
